## Change

What problem does this solve? Include the user-visible behavior or audible change.

## Evidence

Commands run, tests passed, and any checks not run. For DSP changes, include the
reference/tolerance and explain listening evidence separately from measurements.

## Scope

Note compatibility, format or sound changes. Confirm new examples use generated
signals and new dependencies retain provenance and licenses. Do not attach
credentials, private paths, production media or large build artifacts.
